CleanNest Surface Spray is a multi-surface cleaner for kitchen counters, tables, and appliance exteriors. It is not recommended for direct application on unfinished wood. ## NutriMalt Choco Drink
NutriMalt Choco Drink is a malt-based beverage powder with added iron and B vitamins. It is positioned for school-age children and can be served hot or cold. ## GlowSoft Laundry Liquid
GlowSoft Laundry Liquid is a low-foam detergent suitable for front-load washing machines. It is promoted for color care and quick rinsing.

CleanNest Surface Spray should be sprayed onto a cloth for electronics-adjacent cleaning. For food-contact surfaces, wipe again with clean water after use. NutriMalt Choco Drink mixes easily in milk and can also be used in smoothies. One serving provides iron and B vitamins as part of its fortification blend. GlowSoft Laundry Liquid is effective in short wash cycles and is formulated for low suds. It should not be mixed with chlorine bleach in the same wash compartment.
